units.source_text: 她说，是把那个中年女子一直送到下下一个站才回来的。

en.t: She said she had gone with the middle-aged woman as far as the stop after next before coming back.

units.source_text: “真没意思。从前无论办什么事都很齐心，

en.t: It is so dull. In the old days, whatever we did, everyone pulled together,

units.source_text: 可是如今个人主义渐渐抬头，各干各的，意见总是统一不了。

en.t: but now individualism is gradually taking hold, everyone does things their own way, and we can never agree.

units.source_text: 这儿也变化很大，性格合不来的人越来越多了。

en.t: This place has changed a great deal too, and there are more and more people whose temperaments do not suit one another.

units.source_text: 菊勇姐不在，我就寂寞了。

en.t: When Sister Kikuyu is not here, I feel lonely.

units.source_text: 因为过去什么事都是由她拿主意的。

en.t: That is because in the past she was the one who decided everything.

units.source_text: 她最叫座，没少过六百枝［艺妓陪酒是按点香数来计算时间的］的。

en.t: She was the most in demand, and she never had fewer than six hundred sticks, since a geisha's time at a party is counted by sticks of incense.

units.source_text: 她在我们这儿最受器重啦。”

en.t: She was the one we valued most here.
